method.source: in-process display-link tracker (DevModule devTrackStart/devTrackTag): every display tick (120 Hz) reads the folder panel view's effective opacity (product of layer opacities up to the window content view) and its frame converted to window coordinates (includes ancestor scale transforms)
method.latency: first tick at/after mouse-down whose panel opacity differs from the pre-click tick by > 0.01, or whose width/height differs by > 0.5 pt, or where the panel view mounts/unmounts while visible; reported relative to mouse-up (negative = before mouse-up) and to mouse-down
method.settle: first tick after which every tick has opacity within 0.01 of the last tick and width within 1% of it (or stays fully transparent/unmounted when the end state is closed)
method.tickTime: Date.now() when the display-link callback fires; the frame it prepares reaches the screen about one refresh (8.3 ms) later
